cases.complaint_summary: Complainant Rakesh Patel reports Rs. 48,000 debited from his account via an unauthorized UPI collect request received on 12 July 2026. He states he clicked a link received via SMS claiming to be from his bank, entered his UPI PIN believing it was a KYC update request, and the amount was immediately debited.

evidence.ai_description: Screenshot of SMS received claiming to be from bank, containing a payment link.
Bank transaction statement showing Rs. 48,000 debit dated 12 July 2026, RRN 402198337210.

cases.complaint_summary: Complainant Meena Desai lost Rs. 1,20,000 in an investment scam. Was added to a WhatsApp group by an unknown number promising high returns on stock trading, transferred funds to three different bank accounts over two weeks on instruction from group admin, then was removed from the group and admin became unreachable.

evidence.ai_description: WhatsApp group chat screenshots showing investment instructions and admin's messages.
Three separate bank transfer receipts totalling Rs. 1,20,000 over 12-26 July 2026.

cases.note: Deliberately includes a repeated bank account (XXXX-XXXX-7734) also present as a destination in TEST-CYBER-001's layer-2 trail if you cross-link them manually — use this pair to test the mule-account / cross-case correlation feature specifically.
cases.expected_behavior: Should surface as a strong candidate for cross-case correlation once layer2_transaction_trace evidence is added, since it shares a destination account with TEST-CYBER-001's eventual layer-2 (add that account manually to case 001 during testing if you want to force the correlation hit).

cases.complaint_summary: Complainant Sunita Rathod reports her 16-year-old son Arjun Rathod missing since 10 July 2026. Last seen leaving for tuition classes at 5 PM, did not return. Family reports no prior history of running away, phone switched off since that evening.

evidence.ai_description: Recent photograph of missing person provided by family.
Written statement from complainant detailing last-seen circumstances and timeline.

cases.complaint_summary: Used specifically to test escalation logic (Phase 10). Same shape as TEST-CYBER-001 but deliberately has no evidence added and no checklist progress for 3+ analyze cycles.
cases.expected_behavior: Run /analyze on this case 3 times without adding any evidence or completing any step in between — escalation should auto-trigger on the 3rd run per Phase 10's logic.
